items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1996-01-10
items.q: And that's how I really first met Vernon in the ballroom, signing autographs.

ctx.x: Let me kind of billboard this. January 1, no, January the 10th, 1996. This is real number two with Tex Stephens. Okay. Now we can do that.

Ted, we were getting ready to talk about when Winslow was better known as Dr. Daddio on the radio for too many people. Dr. Daddio, as he was widely known, was a very prolific art teacher at Dillon University. He had a beautiful command of the English language. And as they said, that Dr. Daddio would let it all hang out. So what really happened, he and Tom, in fact, Tom Newman was a marketing technician with one of the advertising agencies here in the city of New Orleans. This is how Dr. Daddio really got on the…
is this the guy I was listening to on radio?
